truth_frontmatter.change_reason: UD lock D-VA: plan-review pack=10 from VoltAgent; gate tokens; readiness 1+6; default off

acceptance_criteria.description: 无关键词无 flag → spawn=false, reason=subagent_default_off
「启用子代理」+ 架构/代码审查/全面分析 → pack-review，含 architect-reviewer 与 code-reviewer
`--pack plan-review` 安装恰好 10 角色文件到 host agents dir
每个角色文件含 cannot_complete_goal / cannot_write_truth（或等价 HARD）
`--pack minimal` 仍可装 6 角色（兼容 v1.6.8）
pack-review gate 返回 roles 包含 core 4
全局 on 无阶段词 → pack-default（search-specialist only）
verify-subagent-runtime：1+6 flat skill（任一 beacon-goal 等）可过 skill_root；require-agents 校验 pack
无第二公共 skill 入口（仍 goal/plan）
planner-review 无 host subagent runtime → single_process_multi_reviewer + fallback_reason
examples 含 plan-review on 路径
文档/真相声明全量 VoltAgent dump 为 non-goal

test_rows.command: `python3 -c "from beacon.utils.host_subagent_gate import evaluate_host_subagent_gate as e; g=e('实现登录'); assert g['spawn'] is False and g['reason_code']=='subagent_default_off'"`

`python3 -c "from beacon.utils.host_subagent_gate import evaluate_host_subagent_gate as e; g=e('启用子代理做架构设计与代码审查全面分析'); assert 'pack-review' in g['packs'] and 'architect-reviewer' in g['roles'] and 'code-reviewer' in g['roles']"`
`python3 -c "from beacon.utils.host_subagent_gate import evaluate_host_subagent_gate as e; g=e('并行实现多湖'); assert g['host_agents'] is False"`
`python3 -c "from beacon.utils.host_subagent_gate import evaluate_host_subagent_gate as e, PLAN_REVIEW_CORE_ROLES; g=e('子代理 全面审查'); assert set(PLAN_REVIEW_CORE_ROLES)<=set(g['roles'])"`
`python3 -c "from beacon.utils.host_subagent_gate import evaluate_host_subagent_gate as e; g=e('不要子代理 但启用子代理'); assert g['spawn'] is False"`
`python3 -c "from beacon.utils.host_subagent_gate import evaluate_host_subagent_gate as e; g=e('启用子代理'); assert g['packs']==['pack-default']"`
`python3 -c "from beacon.utils.host_subagent_gate import evaluate_host_subagent_gate as e; g=e('启用子代理 全面审查'); assert g['cannot_complete_goal'] is True"`

`python3 -c "from beacon.utils.planner_review_runtime import build_planner_review_runtime_artifact as b; from pathlib import Path; p=b(project_root=Path('.'),feature='x',version='v1.6.10',prompt='t',subagent_runtime_available=False,write=False); assert p['execution_mode']=='single_process_multi_reviewer' and p['fallback_reason']"`
